Signature

Custom Lipstick

Create your signature shade from scratch with our master colorists. From undertone calibration to custom scent, texture, and finish — craft a one-of-a-kind lip formula that complements your natural complexion and skin tone flawlessly.

Sit at our formulation bar and watch pigments blend in real time. Choose from satin, matte, velvet, or glossy finishes, infuse with organic nourishing botanical oils, and engrave your custom lipstick case with your initials.

What to Expect
  • Live pigment blending at our formulation bar — watch your signature shade come to life in real time.
  • Choose your finish (satin, matte, velvet, or glossy) and infuse with organic nourishing botanical oils.
  • Take home your bespoke lipstick in a personalised engraved case — a truly one-of-a-kind keepsake.
Duration: 45 minutes
Location: ASHTA District 8, SCBD, Jakarta
Investment: IDR 1.200.000
